Judge: python3 docs/testing/perf/pace_check.py <log> --nominal 2 --judge, first line of each process excluded. P1: consecutive hakuX-pace lines are exactly 60 frames apart. P2: v0+v1+v2+v3+v4 == 60 on every line. P3: run mean of vb/60 within 5% of run mean of hakuX-perf Vpf. THE BRIEF ASKED FOR 'late-frame share matches Vpf within 5%'; those are different quantities (Vpf is a mean VBLANKs per flip, the late share is a fraction of flips above nominal), so the leg is registered on the commensurable one, mean VBLANKs per flip. Vpf is an EMA of the SAME per-flip count, so P3 checks windowing and printing, not an independent measurement. P4 (THE IMPOSSIBLE ROW, and the only leg with independent sources): no window reports more VBLANKs than its wall time holds, vb * 16.667 ms <= 1.05 * ms; VBLANKs come from the vblank timer and ms from the flip clock. Fails if the VBLANK delta is taken from the wrong counter or the window is mis-reset. P5: run mean of window fps 60/(ms/1000) within 5% of run mean of hakuX-perf gfps (the per-second flip counter, a separate count). Arm A (a_ref, master) carries no hakuX-pace print by construction and is not run; this is a single-arm instrument check, not an A/B.
